releases.body_excerpt:

* Add Lightning Roulette and GraafOne to Breez's marketplace
* Unhide fiat value in the home screen
* Incremental background chain scan
* Various bug fixes
releases.author: kingonly

releases.name: 0.9 KeySend

* Paste Node ID to spontaneously pay an lnd node (running with --accept-key-send)
* Added FixedFloat to Breez's marketplace
* Support for 'breez:' deep links
releases.author: kingonly

releases.name: 0.8 Point-of-Sale
releases.body_excerpt:
Introducing a new :zap:Point-of-Sale:zap: mode:
* Simple keypad interface for receiving lightning payments.
* Items catalog for fast charge of predefined products (create, edit, delete & search).
* Charge with sats, BTC or selected fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP and JPY) value.
* Set a Manager Password to prevent sending funds by unauthorized personnel.
* Support LNURL-channel for increased capacity.
releases.author: kingonly

releases.name: 0.8 Reverse Swap
releases.body_excerpt:
* 'Remove Funds' now uses Boltz reverse Submarine Swap service
* Better support for hodl invoices
* Buy bitcoin using credit card is now available in the US (via MoonPay)
* Buy bitcoin with SEPA Euro bank transfers (via MoonPay)
* Improved biometrics and PIN screen
* Limit the size of Neutrino db and delete unnecessary filters after validation
* Change 'Sat' unit to 'sats'
* Paste invoice is fixed in Android 10
* Fix crash when syncing old wallets
* Other bug fixes
releases.author: kingonly

releases.name: 0.8 Improvements
releases.body_excerpt:
* Lightning fast on-boarding: initialize Neutrino from last available checkpoint.
* Support lnurl-withdraw via link or scan.
* Biometric support: use fingerprint on Android or Face ID/Touch ID on iPhone to access Breez.
* Pay instantly w/o waiting for on-chain sync.
* Improved graph synchronization.
* Fix refund crash when using non-bech32 address.
* Bug fixes.
releases.author: kingonly
